A wide-angle, low-angle view captures a daytime outdoor parade on a paved street lined with metal barricades and a large crowd of spectators. Several performers carry tall white poles topped with large, multi-colored ribbon rosettes in red, green, and yellow. In the background, a long white banner with blue text reading "Banco Caja Social" is visible along the left side, while yellow banners with the word "SALTO" appear on the right. The sky is clear and blue, and the scene is brightly lit by direct sunlight. The camera movement tracks the parade as it moves from left to right across the frame.
